repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpRrYuqSLCvbSk9zrL

Note for whoever picks this card up (2026-11-24T19:15Z), raised in the L1 review of PR #37075 (seat comment 7141806791). Area: a4-K.

`recordToDocument` (`packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-service.ts`) sets the document `title` from the record whenever the value is a string and not withheld, whether or not the source lists that field among its content fields. Under epic #37000's rule that embedding is egress and a source lists its content fields explicitly, the title is a field that leaves without being listed. PR #37075 does not change this (it keeps reindex and event sync on the same builder). When this card moves the title to the object's display field, decide in the same change whether the title is sent only when the source lists it, or is declared as always sent; otherwise it belongs to the epic's row 3 (the `'*'` retirement).
